controls: Fixed acquisition-time quantiles .25,.375,.5,.625,.75; no CFO values or phase select control boundaries; minimum 3 train and 3 held blocks per side
models: One identity, orbit time and CFO intercept, independent residual scales across each tested boundary versus one shared scale
selection: Fixed candidate bank for all boundaries within a track/fold; mode0 12:00 uses prior segment proposal union; other tracks use prior original banks. No new candidate search.
meaning: Retrospective negative controls, not unseen-scan validation or calibrated significance test
followup_model_mixture: After reviewing boundary controls: half prior on stationary uncertainty, half equally across eligible proposed boundaries. Compare acquisition-triggered proposals against ordinary quantiles; weights from training evidence only. Exploratory follow-up, not a preregistered validation.
